prompts.rifleman:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: game animation sprite sheet.
Edit target image 1 is a transparent reference canvas with the approved overhead infantry sprite in slot one. Image 2 is its detailed original reference. Create a COMPLETE FOUR-FRAME WALK CYCLE of that same character, one horizontal row of four equally spaced square slots. Transparent RGBA background. Forward points exactly UP in ALL frames, fixed overhead orthographic camera.
Keep identical olive uniform, backpack, magenta helmet/shoulder panels and held equipment. Preserve character scale, helmet position, upper torso, arms, equipment, details, palette and lighting across all four frames; ONLY animate alternating knees and boots below backpack. Frame1: left leg forward and right back. Frame2: legs pass in neutral. Frame3: right leg forward and left back. Frame4: legs pass in neutral again. Clearly different leg silhouettes with realistic small stepping range, seamless loop 1-2-3-4. No sideways turning, no rotation, no different facing directions. Do NOT arrange as a character turnaround. Each slot has the same helmet anchor at (50%,50%) and same torso position. Production RTS game sprites, same detailed painted style as input. No ground, shadows on ground, scenery, text, labels or grid lines. Exact four complete figures in a single horizontal row, all fully contained within equal-width slots with transparent margins.
prompts.rifleman_alpha: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this four-frame walk-cycle sprite sheet. Remove the white backdrop completely. Output a truly transparent RGBA PNG: empty canvas pixels alpha 0, painted sprite interior alpha 255. Keep EXACTLY the same four sprites, pixel positions, sizes, spacing, colors and poses. No changes to the artwork, no new backdrop, no white glow, no shadows. This is a production game sprite sheet requiring real transparent cutout around each figure.

rocketeer_stride_corrections: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this transparent four-frame overhead infantry walking sprite sheet. Change ONLY the legs in the THIRD sprite from the left: it currently repeats the FIRST sprite's LEFT boot forward pose. The THIRD sprite must instead have its RIGHT leg and boot extended DOWN toward the bottom edge, and its LEFT knee and boot pulled UP toward the backpack. This is the opposite stride to sprite one, forming a left-neutral-right-neutral loop. Keep the upper body, head, backpack, arms, launcher, magenta panels, scale, all anchor positions identical to the input. Do not modify sprites one, two or four. Exact same canvas and four-slot layout. Preserve real RGBA transparency, empty pixel alpha zero. No background, no labels.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix ONLY the third figure (second from right) on this four-frame transparent sprite sheet.
